name: FunctionType
declaration:
enum FunctionType {
  screen = 'screen',
  layer = 'layer',
  input = 'input',
  preset = 'preset',
  device = 'device',
  system = 'system-functions', // 系统功能
  layerEdit = 'layer-edit', // 图层编辑
  time = 'time-edit', // 时码编辑区
  cueEdit = 'cue-edit', // CUE编辑
  wisdom = 'wisdom-control', //智慧屏
  PTZControl = 'console-tab-PTZ', // 云台控制
  inputParamAdjustment = 'input-param-adjustment', // 输入参数调节
  outputParamAdjustment = 'output-param-adjustment', // 输出参数调节
  layerParamAdjustment = 'layer-param-adjustment', // 图层属性调节
  screenParamAdjustment = 'screen-param-adjustment', // 配屏
  PTZParamAdjustment = 'ptz-param-adjustment', // 云台参数调节
  mvrParamAdjustment = 'mvr-param-adjustment', // mvr
  number = 'number',
}
